canonical.contract: Before canonical backup accepts completed generated media, require a one-to-one receipt/media graph, receipt SHA256 equality and bounded container signatures.

current_semantics.contract: Exact registered path inventory, independent-copy identity/SHA256/size, link and budget guards, saved/recovery source and input-asset validation. It does not claim canonical backup-time completion-receipt graph validation.

Retains known old/incomplete cache files and independently verified file bytes, relocates the saved output folder and keeps recovery/source identity. Manifest limitation now explicitly states passive retention and validation before use.
Opening or recovering a draft clears result. Backup restoration never starts a worker, selects a provider, or turns a saved journal into a playable/complete Studio result.

On an explicit consumer call, validate current receipt/key, media size/SHA256, real PCM frames/rate/channels and companion hashes; quarantine invalid data without silently releasing its storage budget.

Hold an immutable verified reader across current checksum and bounded media validation; verify actual PCM master/stems and measured result fields, plus selected encoded-container signatures. A self-consistent malformed completion raises before new operation admission, quarantine or regeneration. Existing explicit-render repair of checksum-damaged output remains a separate retained behavior.
A new publication independently validates exact typed-plan/source/timeline/artifact binding and actual master PCM. The passive backup never supplies publication approval.
These current completed-output namespaces already validate their own typed graphs and actual PCM during backup; they are not weakened to the passive Studio-cache policy.
Preserve original historical state and manifests passively under existing bounds. This repair does not reinterpret their old cache format as current completion or reject valid historical drafts.

concrete_gap.before: A caller could reseal invalid audio bytes into complete.json and satisfy old _verified_output SHA/size/name checks, then receive a completed result. The existing cache-only PCM check did not cover this completed-render path.
concrete_gap.after: The existing completed-output consumer now rejects that internally inconsistent media claim without activating a decoder/voice, mutating its directory or converting it into a fresh regeneration request.

limits: Source-only review and authored tests are not execution results.
Backup-time canonical graph validation and current passive-cache retention are deliberately distinguished; no blanket timing or case-count equivalence is claimed.
Encoded-container signature checks are bounded identification, not a complete decode, perceptual audio assessment, real-model qualification or NVDA acceptance.
No arbitrary runtime/model/profile authority is restored or inferred from cached paths.
Historical malformed or incomplete cache bytes can remain archived passively; only explicit consumers may evaluate or quarantine them.
